## AI Engineer Intern
We are looking for a passionate AI Engineer Intern to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with senior engineers to explore, build, and deploy AI/ML applications, with a specific focus on Generative AI and LLMs. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience with state-of-the-art technologies in a professional environment.
## Responsibilities:
- Understand & Learn: Deeply understand project objectives and study data hypotheses under the guidance of senior team members.
- Research & Implement: Participate in researching and implementing algorithms for data science and AI projects.
- Gen AI Development: Assist in prototyping features using Gen AI capabilities (LLMs, AI Agents, Embeddings) and basic NLP concepts.
- Testing & Evaluation: Support the team in testing and benchmarking AI models using established evaluation frameworks.
- Stay Updated: Proactively stay informed about the latest research, trends, and technologies in Data Science and AI.
## Requirements:
- Education: Final-year university student or recent graduate (&lt;1 year of experience in the AI field) in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field.
- Programming: Strong foundation in Python and familiarity with data structures and algorithms.
- AI/ML Knowledge: Basic understanding of Machine Learning/Deep Learning concepts. Interest in LLMs and agentic frameworks (e.g., Lang Chain, Google ADK) is a major plus.
- Tools: Familiarity with version control (Git). Basic knowledge of containerization (Docker) is preferred.
- Cloud: Basic awareness of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is an advantage.
## Soft Skills:
- Fluent in English (strong ability to read technical documentation and communicate effectively).
- Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven mindset.
- Eager to learn, proactive, and highly responsible.

## Data Science Intern
We are seeking a curious and analytical Data Science Intern to join our team. In this role, you will support data scientists in performing exploratory data analysis, building predictive models, and translating complex data into actionable insights. You will gain hands-on experience with real-world datasets and modern MLOps practices.
## Responsibilities:
- Data Analysis: Formulate and evaluate data hypotheses; perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover key patterns and trends.
- Modeling: Research, implement, and evaluate machine learning, statistical, or NLP algorithms tailored to project requirements.
- Collaboration: Work closely with senior team members and business stakeholders to understand domain needs and project objectives.
- Continuous Learning: Stay current with emerging research, methodologies, and industry trends in data science.
- Documentation: Document experimental workflows, model architectures, and performance metrics clearly.
## Requirements:
- Education: Final-year student or recent graduate (<1 year of relevant experience) pursuing or holding a degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
## Technical Skills:
- High proficiency in Python and SQL.
- Practical experience with core data science libraries (e.g., Pandas, Num Py, Scikit-Learn, Matplotlib) through academic or practical projects.
- Foundational knowledge in one or more core domains: Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, or Applied Statistics.
- Ability to read, synthesize, and implement techniques from technical research papers.
## Soft Skills:
- Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
- Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities.
- Collaborative team player capable of communicating complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
## Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure).
- Understanding of core MLOps principles, such as model tracking and automated pipelines.
- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau, or Streamlit).
